• Architecting and developing agentic AI components for IQVIA's AI Assistant, enabling intelligent automation and decision-making, reducing manual data retrieval by 80% through real-time RAG and ReAct Agents.

• Developed an illusion benchmark to evaluate the visual understanding of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), published my work at COLM'24.
  • Conducted research on multimodal deep learning and VLMs for my undergraduate thesis, focusing on text-image understanding and fusion techniques.
  • Curated a large-scale dataset of newspaper articles, images, and summaries to enhance abstractive summarization, integrating image data for improved VLM performance.

• Worked with the powerplant maintenance team to develop a Multi-Layer Perceptron and an LSTM model to analyze the powerplant performance level and failure prediction.
  • Analyzed powerplant sensor data to employ data-cleaning and feature engineering techniques that allowed the machine learning model to predict with better accuracy.
